name: Skepsis Review
description: Local browser-based diff and repository code review powered by Skepsis, wired directly to Orca agents.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Open Skepsis code review in browser

settings.title: Browser Open Command
settings.description: Optional command used to open the review URL (the URL is passed as the last argument). Leave empty to use the system default browser; e.g. open -a "Google Chrome" on macOS.

settings.title: Tab Size
settings.description: Tab width in columns shown in Skepsis diffs and files.

settings.title: Default Diff Base
settings.description: Optional git/jj base revision for diffs (e.g. HEAD or origin/main). Leave empty for Skepsis auto merge-base (with automatic HEAD fallback).

settings.title: Orca CLI Path
settings.description: Optional explicit path to the orca CLI binary. Leave empty to use orca on PATH or the macOS Orca.app bundle.

settings.title: Remote SSH Host Overrides
settings.description: Optional mapping from Orca remote environment/host names to ~/.ssh/config aliases (one per line: name=ssh-alias). Leave empty to use the Orca host name directly.

settings.title: Remote Node.js Path
settings.description: Optional path to Node.js 22+ on remote SSH hosts (e.g. /usr/local/bin/node). Leave empty to auto-detect on the remote host.
